Bid Opportunities

Work With the SRD

The Strathcona Regional District will post all bid opportunities on this page. Bidders are encouraged to carefully review bid documents in their entirety to ensure their bids comply with the terms and conditions of the procurement process and avoid disqualification.

If you wish to be notified by email of any new bid or tender opportunities, you can subscribe to our notification service.

Land Acknowledgement

The Strathcona Regional District respectfully acknowledges that its corporate office and Strathcona Gardens Recreation Complex are located on the traditional unceded territory of the Ligʷiłdax̌ʷ people. 

It is also recognized that the SRD operates within the traditional, treaty and unceded territories of the Ehattesaht / Chinehkint, Homalco, Ka:'yu:'k't'h' / Che: k'tles7et'h’, Klahoose, K’ómoks, Kwiakah, Mowachaht / Muchalaht, Nuchatlaht, Tla’amin, Tlowitsis, We Wai Kai and Wei Wai Kum First Nations.
